items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: there was another fine piano player, fine pianist, Raymond Walters, was playing piano. And I think Raymond left the trio for one reason or the other.

ctx.x: Well, Stuff and John were working together in Chicago, and there was another fine piano player,

fine pianist, Raymond Walters, was playing piano. And I think Raymond left the trio for one reason or the other. And John wrote me a letter. I was just working with a small group, a local group, just around outside of Chicago.
